sourceNotes.rawContent:
Make every festive look unforgettable with this Traditional Kundan Bracelet Watch, featuring an elegant antique gold finish, sparkling Kundan stones, vibrant red & green accents, and delicate hanging bead details. Designed to resemble a statement bracelet, this watch beautifully combines traditional Indian craftsmanship with everyday functionality.
Whether paired with a saree, lehenga, salwar suit, or Indo-western outfit, this designer watch adds a regal charm to every occasion.
Features
-
Premium antique gold finish
-
Traditional Kundan stone craftsmanship
-
Red & green stone embellishments
-
Elegant dangling bead detailing
-
Adjustable chain for a comfortable fit
-
Lightweight & skin-friendly
-
Perfect for weddings, festivals, parties & gifting
Package Includes: 1 Traditional Bracelet Watch
